dedupe_keys.name: amenagement de deflecteurs de courant favorisant la dynamique fluviale

description: Aménagement de déflecteurs de courant favorisant la dynamique fluviale is a dataset listed in The Luxembourg Data Platform, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Administration de la gestion de l'eau. Initiation of a river dynamic by setting up deflector spikes such as dead wood or stones, with the aim of initiating the formation of diversified structures in the river bed and on the banks (scouring, sedimentation zones, alluvial banks, bank breaks, etc.) offering varied habitats for aquatic fauna and flora. Coverage: Administration de la gestion de l'eau. The portal shows the English title as "Arrangement of current deflectors promoting river dynamics" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Administration de la gestion de l'eau. Its keywords include hydromorphologie, hymo, berge, programmedemesure2021, coursdeau, geoportail-lu. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is cc-zero. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-la-plateforme-de-donnees-luxembourgeoise.
